description: Open-source, web-based dance game. Dance along to any video, get real-time key-pose feedback during the dance, and full scoring with playback review after. Dynamic dance library from YouTube URLs, session recording with replay, practice mode for learning, and comprehensive test coverage. Runs entirely in the browser with a lightweight backend for video processing.

phase0.name: Foundation (Complete)
phase0.description: Project scaffold, pose estimation, scoring algorithms, basic UI. All original stories delivered.

phase1.name: Core Polish & Bug Fixes
phase1.description: Make what exists work well. Fix bugs, improve UX, polish the UI.

phase2.name: Dance Library & YouTube Integration
phase2.description: Dynamic dance library. Users paste a YouTube URL, app processes it, and it appears in their library. Backend for video processing pipeline.

phase3.name: Recording & Replay
phase3.description: Capture user dance sessions (webcam video + tracking data) and allow replay/review of past performances.

phase4.name: Practice Mode
phase4.description: Controlled learning experience: pause, scrub, loop sections, slow motion.

phase5.name: Testing & Quality
phase5.description: Comprehensive Playwright browser tests, visual regression testing, end-to-end test suite so the agent can see and fix visual issues.
